**Actions taken:**

2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) describing the unhealthy deploy and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer. (Note: the first attempt to create the incident timed out, so I verified no incident existed before retrying — no duplicates were created.)
